notes.text:
An update is available for webkit2gtk3.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
WebKitGTK is the port of the portable web rendering engine WebKit to the GTK platform.

Security Fix(es):

* chromium-browser: angle: ANGLE in Google Chrome: Information disclosure via out-of-bounds read (CVE-2026-87596)

* chromium-browser: angle: ANGLE in Google Chrome: Arbitrary code execution via crafted HTML page (CVE-2026-87500)

* chromium-browser: angle: Chromium: Arbitrary code execution via buffer overflow in ANGLE (CVE-2026-87654)

* chromium-browser: angle: Google Chrome (ANGLE): Arbitrary Code Execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-87621)

* chromium-browser: angle: Chromium-browser: Arbitrary code execution via use-after-free vulnerability in ANGLE (CVE-2026-87512)

* chromium-browser: angle: ANGLE: Arbitrary code execution in Google Chrome due to use-after-free (CVE-2026-87648)

* chromium-browser: angle: ANGLE in Google Chrome: Information disclosure via crafted HTML page (CVE-2026-87602)

* chromium-browser: angle: ANGLE in Google Chrome: Information disclosure via crafted HTML page (CVE-2026-87586)

* chromium-browser: angle: ANGLE in Google Chrome: Arbitrary code execution via out-of-bounds read (CVE-2026-87604)

* chromium-browser: angle: chromium-browser: Improper input validation in ANGLE (CVE-2026-91738)

* chromium-browser: angle: chromium-browser: Uninitialized resource in ANGLE (CVE-2026-91720)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* webkit2gtk3 2.54.0 regression breaks Eclipse IDE WebKit-based views on CentOS Stream 9 [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-274406)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
